svg.title: Signal and Execution Layer L4 and L5 Architecture
svg.desc: Level 4: Regime state and context score inputs flow through SAMTC signal generation, pre-trade risk checks, position sizing, execution API, and post-trade monitoring. Level 5 adds ML timing, execution algorithm, TCA, and auto-shutdown.
svg.text: Composite −1 to +1 · Vol regime · CE1–CE3 outputs
Multi-TF breakout confirmation · Breakout z-score ≥ 1.5 · Structural alignment check
Output: direction · entry price · raw stop distance OR no_signal
Regime prob ≥ 0.65 · Daily loss < 2% account · Open exposure < 4% account
BOCPD cp_prob < 0.85 · Vol regime permits entry → PASS or BLOCK
conviction = max(P_bull, P_bear) · vol_scalar per vol regime · transition_scalar = 1 − (cp × 0.5)
size = base_risk × conviction × vol_scalar × transition_scalar → lot size in units
Place entry order · Set stop loss · Set take profit · Log trade with full metadata
Just Market MT5 API — XAUUSD spot
Darwinex REST API — GC futures / GLD / SLV
POST-TRADE MONITORING: live IC · rolling Sharpe · drawdown monitor · regime change → review open positions
LEVEL 5 — WORLD CLASS UPGRADES (delta from L4)
Trained on CE features → return labels
Transaction Cost Analysis vs backtest model
vs SAMTC IC vs sizing contribution
Tracks live vs backtest divergence daily
